It has about $29k of liquidity, which is more than its market cap, and 100% of the LP is unlocked. About $460k of volume went through in roughly 15 minutes: 2,540 buys from 1,094 unique buyers, but only about 110 unique sellers. GMGN flags 100 bundler wallets, and bundlers make up 32% of top traders. At least 10 same-name tokens launched within about 45 minutes. The leader, 5wW9…, is older, at about $297k market cap with $831k of volume in the last hour. Another clone, JqHK…, has almost the same numbers as this one ($28.9k liquidity, $18.7k market cap, $448k volume), which suggests one operator deploying templated clones with farmed volume.
